entities.summary: Founded in 970 CE in Cairo by the Fatimid Caliphate, Al-Azhar is one of the oldest continuously operating universities in the world. Initially a center of Ismaili Shia learning, it became the foremost Sunni theological institution under Saladin. For over a millennium, it has been the supreme authority on Islamic jurisprudence and Arabic linguistics.
